lines.text: Don't drown the nigiri.|Dip the fish — just a touch.
Then I ate it|in one bite, like a local.
One bite. No mess.|The chef smiled.
Dry rice, wet fish.|One bite. That's sushi.
The nigiri is fish|on a pillow of rice.|Drown the rice, and it falls apart.
Dip the fish side,|just a touch.|Soy sauce is a seasoning,|not a swimming pool.
Eat it in one bite.|The chef made it|that size for a reason.
That's Japan first times.|Follow for more.
